276874200.description:
Hemingray Glass Insulators Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray Glass Company, No. 17 and Patent 1893 Models
Aqua Blue and Clear, Vintage 19th to 20th Century
This collection features three vintage glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, once the world's largest manufacturer of glass insulators. These utilitarian pieces were originally designed to support telegraph and telephone wires, and are now highly sought after for their iconic industrial aesthetic and diverse color variations.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua Blue glass, marked "HEMINGRAY" and "PATENT MAY 2 1893," featuring sharp drip points on the base edge.
Insulator, Clear glass, marked "HEMINGRAY-17," featuring a smooth flared base with a textured grip ring.
Insulator, Clear glass, marked "HEMINGRAY-17," featuring a smooth flared base with a textured grip ring.
Condition:
The aqua blue insulator shows significant internal soot or carbon deposits and surface grime from authentic outdoor service. The clear insulators show minor surface wear and occasional internal bubbles characteristic of molded utility glass. No significant structural cracks are observed, though minor fleabites consistent with industrial usage may be present along the base edges.
